title: CPSC, Amen Wardy Home Announce Recall of Multi-purpose Lighters Shaped Like Matchsticks
summary: The lighters lack child-resistant mechanisms that meet federal safety standards. Young children could operate these lighters, which poses a fire hazard. Units: 2,400.

title: CPSC, Homelite Announce Recall of Chainsaws
summary: These saws can operate while the engine is at the "idle" setting, posing a risk of serious lacerations to the operator and bystanders. Units: 6,900.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Announce Recall of Fabric Lanterns
summary: The fabric is not flame retardant and can be ignited by the lantern's votive candle, posing a fire hazard. Units: 64,000.

title: CPSC, Baby's Dream Furniture Inc. Announce Recall to Repair Cribs
summary: The three hinges along the fold-down drop gate can crack or break and allow babies to have their fingers pinched. Additionally, a misaligned latch where the latch trigger does not lock securely can allow the drop gate to open if a child leans on it, and the child could fall out. Units: About 4,600.

title: CPSC, Conceptual Marketing & Development, Inc., Announce Recall of Weed Cutting Attachment Blades
summary: The blades can break off and hit consumers, causing severe impact and laceration injuries. Units: Approximately 1.1 million.

title: CPSC, Stihl Inc. Announce Recall of Chain Saws
summary: In some units, the fuel tank vent could be installed incorrectly and become dislodged. If this occurs, fuel could leak and result in a fire. Units: 13,000.

title: CPSC, Central Sprinkler Company Update Voluntary Recall To Replace O-Ring Fire Sprinklers
summary: These sprinkler heads can corrode or minerals, salts and other contaminants in water can affect the rubber O-ring seals. These factors could cause the sprinkler heads not to activate in a fire. Units: 35 million.

title: CPSC, Starbucks Coffee Co. Announce Recall of Children's Tumbler Cups
summary: When the flexible straw on the cups is chewed, small pieces of plastic can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 30,000.

title: CPSC, International Playthings Inc. Announce Recall of Toy Vehicles
summary: Small parts on the vehicles can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 126,000.

title: CPSC, Lane Furniture Industries Inc. Announce Recall of High-Leg Recliner Chairs
summary: A mechanism in the footrest can create a pinch point that can cause injury if consumers open or recline the chair by reaching underneath the footrest. Units: 620,000.

title: CPSC, Monarch Velo, LLC doing business as Catlike USA Announce Recall of Bike Helmets
summary: The helmets fail impact testing required under CPSC's safety standard for bicycle helmets, violating the Consumer Product Safety Act. Units: 2,250.

title: CPSC, Sea Gull Lighting Inc. Announce Recall of Ceiling Light Fixtures
summary: The wiring in the lights can short, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 7,100.

title: CPSC, The Step2 Company Announce Recall of Toy Drumsticks
summary: The tip of the drumstick can break off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 800.

title: CPSC, United General Supply Co. Announce Recall of Extension Cords
summary: The extension cords have undersized conductors and no over-current protection, which causes overheating, presenting a shock and fire hazard. Units: 8,200.

title: CPSC, Swimways Corp. Announce Recall of Pool Dive Sticks
summary: Children can fall or land on these dive sticks in shallow water and may suffer impalement injuries. Units: About 25,000 packages.
